_validation_note: Fourteen-day window (2026-09-26 to 2026-10-10) searched across facilities, vehicles, capital_sovereignty and regulatory lanes; no candidate survived. Broadened once to 21 days (2026-09-19 to 2026-10-10) and re-screened. In-window candidates were a same-chain repeat of the 2026-09-25 TCEQ permit pause or the 2026-10-09 Taylor cooling-water framework, a withdrawn PUCT large-load target without new primary evidence, outside AI or Texas data-center scope, or actor-led with no statutory authority or binary decision in the primary text (the 2026-09-24 Attorney General release, fetched and audited this run). Gate results are not scored for a no-target run.

verified_facts.claim: The DIR page for DIR-CPO-5148 states that DIR will expire the contract and that the term ends on 9/3/2026.

The Comptroller's September 30, 2026 release states that the executive order directs the agency to publish a proposed amendment to Rule 3.330 to remove marketplace and platform fees from the definition of taxable data processing services.
The Texas Water Development Board's September 10, 2026 board agenda memo covers the 2026-27 Flood Infrastructure Fund Intended Use Plan.
The Governor's release dated June 24, 2026 announces the eighth Texas Energy Fund loan, for 860 MW of new power in Ward County, under the In-ERCOT Generation Loan Program.
The PUC Texas Energy Fund page states that In-ERCOT Generation Loan Program loans are 20-year loans at a fixed 3% interest rate.

dropped_mechanisms.name: Attorney General data-center water-survey investigation
dropped_mechanisms.news_trigger: Attorney General investigation of data-center developments that did not answer the TWDB water-use survey, reported in late September 2026.
dropped_mechanisms.drop_reason: The fetched primary release (dated September 24, 2026) names the actor and an investigation of developments that have not answered the TWDB water-use survey, but it cites no statutory investigative authority, no civil investigative demand, and no binary decision that the office controls. The actor-action-authority passage therefore fails the chokepoint and mechanism-not-actor gates. The release is also actor-led and contains political statements, and it overlaps the excluded TCEQ permit pause chain.
